nodes.text: Pattern Tuesday 🧩 Show me a pattern. Repeats, rhythms, grids, stripes - patterns hide in plain sight. Show me the one your eye keeps coming back to. This rosette repeats at three sizes, one cluster doing the whole pattern - find me a pattern. ONE photo. Replying is consent: • Top 3 featured tomorrow: Threads post + Instagram reel, pinned • Full credit to the author everywhere • Standouts may join a best-of-the-week reel What pattern stopped you today?
photos: Description: A close-up, top-down shot of a pale green rosette succulent with intricate, layered geometric leaves. Water droplets cling to the lower petals, and surrounding foliage creates a natural garden setting. Photograph read: The centered subject is lit by even, natural daylight, highlighting the crisp geometric patterns and textures of the overlapping leaves. Photo type: Nature photography

nodes.text: Take a Seat Friday favorites 🏆 3 seats that stopped my scroll: Margaret Terry @storycatcher52 - sunset dock chairs Paul @londonlightcreative - S-curve bench from above 57 Chev nancychevalier - midnight bench rest Beautiful work, all of you. Reel: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dfbi5_aj1KQ/
photos: Description: Two bright turquoise Adirondack chairs sit side by side on a wooden dock overlooking a serene lake at sunset. The golden evening sun dips below the tree line in the distance, casting warm light and a shimmering reflection across the water. Photograph read: The low-angle diagonal composition leads the eye past the vibrant teal chairs toward the glowing sunset reflecting off the calm water, creating a tranquil and inviting mood. Photo type: Snapshot

Description: A traveler wearing a red garment and white hat sleeps on a wooden bench at night, flanked by backpacks. The scene is set on a patterned tile sidewalk in front of multi-story buildings. Photograph read: Captured from a high angle in low light, the vertical composition centers the resting figure against a backdrop of storefronts, creating a quiet and solitary mood. Photo type: Snapshot
watch_outs: Sun disc clipped to white with reflection streaks on the water surface
Soft overall; intentional or missed focus not determinable from the image.

replies.text: @storycatcher52 Your sunset chairs open the Take a Seat Friday favorites. Two turquoise chairs with front-row seats to that sun path - is this your own dock, and how many evenings end exactly like this one?
Thank you so much for featuring my photo! The dark belongs to my good friend Cottage in Ontario. I donated them to my friends when I sold my own cottage in Wisconsin.
Those chairs landed in exactly the right spot. Thanks for telling their story.

@londonlightcreative Your S-curve bench is the middle slide of the Take a Seat Friday favorites. From above it turns into pure line and rhythm - how did you spot that the curve only shows itself from up high?
If you know about Hogarth’s “Line of Beauty” you know. Many thanks for the feature. Paul 😎
nancychevalier Your midnight bench closes the Take a Seat Friday favorites. A white sunhat, a red wrap, and a long wait under the streetlights - whose journey was this, and where were they headed?
